text_block_list.text: One day, at the training track――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Today's training plan is... Hm, cloudy 
weather, is it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...It's about time. All right, you there! 
I require your input!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Researching a new running style versus 
split-second decision-making. Which will 
you prioritize today?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, great answer! An Umamusume's 
running technique is always progressing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see. In a race, a split-second decision 
can be fatal. Speed of thought is indeed 
critical.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll keep that in mind. I 
wonder what kind of results this little 
coincidence will bring?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Chance occurrences, serendipity――these are 
factors that simply cannot be dismissed in 
research, wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I took advantage of two 
incidental 'flukes'—the overcast sky, and 
you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You too should embrace serendipity to 
prevent falling into a rut! That is the 
path toward truth!
